purpose: Exact, path-scoped allowlist of known committed synthetic/sentinel credentials used by Fast English redaction proofs and disposable-PocketBase smoke tests. The OMP project secret scan (scripts/omp-secret-scan.sh) keeps its full-tree pattern and only drops a scan hit when the assigned value is an exact match for an entry below at the exact same path. A real credential pattern anywhere else — or the same value at an unexpected path — still fails validation. Do not add real credentials here; add a value here only when it is a committed synthetic credential whose path and value are publicly reviewed.
